1|#!/usr/bin/env bash
2|# runners-snapshot.sh <outdir> [--require-converged] — record the fleet matrix
3|# (GET /runners + GET /deploy/status) and a per-runner convergence verdict.
4|# READ-ONLY against the backend; safe to run any time, any number of times.
5|#
6|# Outputs in <outdir>:
7|#   runners-<stamp>.json        raw GET /runners payload (evidence)
8|#   runners-<stamp>.tsv         flat fleet table incl. build sha/builtAt
9|#   deploy-status-<stamp>.json  raw GET /deploy/status payload
10|#   verdict-<stamp>.txt         one line per named runner: CONVERGED or the reasons why not
11|#
12|# Convergence rule (S5 success criterion 1): runnerVersion >= 0.2.x AND the
13|# running build's reported git sha contains the fix commit — verified locally
14|# with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <fixCommit> <buildSha>`, because a version
15|# string alone cannot prove which code is running. If the runner reports no
16|# build sha, the verdict says so instead of guessing.
17|#
18|# Knobs (env):
19|#   KAINBAIN_API_BASE            default http://192.168.1.206:3100
20|#   KAINBAIN_S5_NAMED_RUNNERS    default "local-alpha,server2-alpha"
21|#   KAINBAIN_S5_FIX_COMMIT       default 046a63917d52181d00efbd4a6624bd1c53131fa4 (the 046a6391 deterministic-git-failure change)
22|#
23|# Exit codes: 0 snapshot written (converged or not — read verdict-<stamp>.txt);
24|#   1 setup or API failure (nothing trustworthy written);
25|#   3 snapshot written, --require-converged given, but not all named runners converged.
26|set -euo pipefail
27|SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
28|# shellcheck source=lib.sh
29|source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib.sh"
30|
31|# fix_in_build <buildSha|""|null> — prints true/false/null. null = cannot tell
32|# (no sha reported, or sha unknown to the local repo). Uses the local Kainbain
33|# checkout as the commit database — read-only git queries only.
34|fix_in_build() {
35|  local sha="$1" repo_root="$2" fix_commit="$3"
36|  if [ -z "$sha" ] || [ "$sha" = "null" ]; then
37|    echo null
38|    return 0
39|  fi
40|  if ! git -C "$repo_root" cat-file -e "$sha^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
41|    echo null
42|    return 0
43|  fi
44|  if git -C "$repo_root" merge-base --is-ancestor "$fix_commit" "$sha" 2>/dev/null; then
45|    echo true
46|  else
47|    echo false
48|  fi
49|}
50|
51|# verdict_for <runners.json> <runnerId> — prints the verdict JSON object for one
52|# runner (jq/runner-verdict.jq + the git ancestry check).
53|verdict_for() {
54|  local runners_json="$1" runner_id="$2" repo_root="$3" fix_commit="$4"
55|  local runner sha fix
56|  runner="$(jq -c --arg id "$runner_id" '.[] | select(.runnerId == $id) // empty' "$runners_json")"
57|  if [ -z "$runner" ]; then
58|    printf '{"runnerId":"%s","converged":false,"reasons":["runner not present in GET /runners (offline/revoked?)"]}\n' "$runner_id"
59|    return 0
60|  fi
61|  sha="$(printf '%s' "$runner" | jq -r '.facts.versions.build.sha // ""')"
62|  fix="$(fix_in_build "$sha" "$repo_root" "$fix_commit")"
63|  jq -n -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/jq/runner-verdict.jq" --argjson runner "$runner" --argjson fixInBuild "$fix"
64|}
65|
66|main() {
67|  require_commands curl jq git date mktemp
68|  local outdir="${1:-}"
69|  [ -n "$outdir" ] || die "usage: runners-snapshot.sh <outdir> [--require-converged]"
70|  local require_converged=0
71|  if [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then
72|    [ "$2" = "--require-converged" ] || die "usage: runners-snapshot.sh <outdir> [--require-converged] — unexpected argument '$2'"
73|    require_converged=1
74|  fi
75|  [ $# -le 2 ] || die "usage: runners-snapshot.sh <outdir> [--require-converged] — unexpected extra argument '$3'"
76|
77|  local api_base="${KAINBAIN_API_BASE:-http://192.168.1.206:3100}"
78|  local named="${KAINBAIN_S5_NAMED_RUNNERS:-local-alpha,server2-alpha}"
79|  [ -n "${named//[[:space:],]/}" ] || die "no named runners to check (KAINBAIN_S5_NAMED_RUNNERS is empty) — nothing to do"
80|  local fix_commit="${KAINBAIN_S5_FIX_COMMIT:-046a63917d52181d00efbd4a6624bd1c53131fa4}"
81|  local task_dir repo_root stamp
82|  task_dir="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
83|  repo_root="$(git -C "$task_dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
84|  # Second precision: two snapshots in the same minute must not overwrite each other.
85|  stamp="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
86|  mkdir -p "$outdir"
87|
88|  log "runners-snapshot api=$api_base outdir=$outdir named=$named fix=$fix_commit"
89|
90|  local runners_json="$outdir/runners-$stamp.json" deploy_json="$outdir/deploy-status-$stamp.json"
91|  api_get_json "$api_base/runners" "$runners_json" \
92|    || die "GET $api_base/runners failed — nothing written to $outdir"
93|  # /runners must be an array of runner objects; anything else (an error
94|  # envelope, an HTML page that slipped through) would make every downstream
95|  # verdict meaningless, so stop here with a clear message.
96|  if ! jq -e 'type == "array"' "$runners_json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
97|    rm -f "$runners_json"
98|    die "GET $api_base/runners returned valid JSON that is not an array — refusing to build a verdict from it"
99|  fi
100|  local deploy_ok=1
101|  api_get_json "$api_base/deploy/status" "$deploy_json" \
102|    || { log "WARN: GET /deploy/status failed — continuing with /runners only"; rm -f "$deploy_json"; deploy_ok=0; }
103|
104|  jq -r -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/jq/runners-tsv.jq" "$runners_json" > "$outdir/runners-$stamp.tsv"
105|
106|  local verdict_json="$outdir/verdict-$stamp.json" verdict_txt="$outdir/verdict-$stamp.txt"
107|  local verdict_body
108|  verdict_body="$(mktemp)"
109|  : > "$verdict_json.tmp.$$"
110|  local IFS=',' r all_converged=1 v
111|  # Named runners come from env, so tolerate "a, b" spacing and stray commas.
112|  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
113|  for r in $named; do
114|    r="${r//[[:space:]]/}"
115|    [ -n "$r" ] || continue
116|    v="$(verdict_for "$runners_json" "$r" "$repo_root" "$fix_commit")"
117|    printf '%s\n' "$v" >> "$verdict_json.tmp.$$"
118|    if printf '%s' "$v" | jq -e '.converged == true' >/dev/null; then
119|      printf 'CONVERGED    %s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$v" | jq -r '[.runnerId, .runnerVersion, (.buildSha // "no-sha")] | join(" ")')" >> "$verdict_body"
120|    else
121|      all_converged=0
122|      printf 'NOT-CONVERGED %s — %s\n' "$r" "$(printf '%s' "$v" | jq -r '.reasons | join("; ")')" >> "$verdict_body"
123|    fi
124|  done
125|  jq -s '.' "$verdict_json.tmp.$$" > "$verdict_json" && rm -f "$verdict_json.tmp.$$"
126|
127|  {
128|    echo "# runner convergence verdict — $(date -u +%FT%TZ) — fix commit $fix_commit"
129|    echo "# converged = runnerVersion >= 0.2.x AND running build sha contains the fix commit"
130|    cat "$verdict_body"
131|  } > "$verdict_txt" && rm -f "$verdict_body"
132|
133|  if [ "$deploy_ok" = 1 ]; then
134|    echo "wrote $outdir/runners-$stamp.{json,tsv} $outdir/deploy-status-$stamp.json $outdir/verdict-$stamp.{json,txt}"
135|  else
136|    echo "wrote $outdir/runners-$stamp.{json,tsv} $outdir/verdict-$stamp.{json,txt} (no deploy-status: GET /deploy/status failed)"
137|  fi
138|  cat "$outdir/runners-$stamp.tsv"
139|  echo "--- verdict:"
140|  cat "$verdict_txt"
141|
142|  if [ "$require_converged" = 1 ] && [ "$all_converged" = 0 ]; then
143|    log "--require-converged: not all named runners converged (see $verdict_txt)"
144|    exit 3
145|  fi
146|}
147|
148|if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
149|  main "$@"
150|fi

1|# S5 ops scripts — fleet recount, runner snapshots, E5 sweep
2|
3|Read-only evidence tooling for task `683f0bfd` (0.2.x rollout + interrupt

5|state, and runner-host worktrees/journals. Nothing here restarts, updates,
6|reaps, or otherwise mutates any runner or the backend.
7|
8|## Scripts
9|
10|| Script | Purpose |
11||---|---|
12|| `fleet-recount.sh <label> [task-dir]` | GUIDE-07 §5 recount + WIDE_NET §2 table over one project. Writes `recount-<label>.jsonl`, `-table.json`, `-e5worklist.json`, `-errors.jsonl`, `-meta.json`, plus `raw/<label>/<taskId>.json` evidence. |
13|| `runners-snapshot.sh <outdir> [--require-converged]` | Records GET /runners + GET /deploy/status and a per-runner convergence verdict (version ≥ 0.2.x AND build sha contains the fix commit, checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`). |
14|| `e5-sweep.sh <local\|server2> <prefix>...` | GUIDE-05 §4 forensics sweep: per `kb-<taskId>`, reports worktree state, origin refs, stage-output-commit presence, journal lines, and one VERDICT line. |
15|| `server2-ssh.sh <remote command>` | SSH to the server2-alpha host via `~/.passwrd` without ever printing it. Read-only use only. |
16|| `lib.sh` | Shared helpers (sourced, never run): logging, validated JSON GET, atomic writes, input guards. |
17|| `jq/*.jq` | The aggregation rules. `per-task.jq` + `aggregate.jq` output is pinned byte-identical against the recorded before-table by the test suite. |
18|
19|## Exit codes
20|
21|- `fleet-recount.sh`: 0 all tasks ok · 1 task list unusable, nothing written · 2 some tasks failed (errors file lists them, table still written)
22|- `runners-snapshot.sh`: 0 snapshot written · 1 setup/API failure · 3 snapshot written but `--require-converged` not met
23|- `e5-sweep.sh`: 0 all probed · 1 usage/setup error · 2 some probes failed (per-task VERDICT still printed)
24|- `server2-ssh.sh`: remote exit code on success · 64 no command · 66 password file missing/empty · 69 no sshpass/pexpect · 124 ssh timeout
25|
26|## Environment knobs
27|
28|`KAINBAIN_API_BASE` (default `http://192.168.1.206:3100`),
29|`KAINBAIN_PROJECT_ID`, `KAINBAIN_S5_NAMED_RUNNERS`,
30|`KAINBAIN_S5_FIX_COMMIT`, `E5_WORK_ROOT`, `E5_UNIT`, `E5_ORIGIN_REPO`,
31|`E5_JOURNAL_SINCE`. Each script header documents the ones it reads.
32|
33|## Tests
34|
35|```sh
36|bin/tests/run-tests.sh   # offline: recorded fixtures + local mock API, exit 0 = all pass
37|```
38|
39|Nothing in the suite touches prod. Re-run it after any change to `*.sh`,
40|`jq/*.jq`, or `tests/mock-api.py` — T1 fails if the aggregation output
41|drifts from the recorded before-table.
42|
43|## Safety rules for operators
44|
45|1. Observe only — never force-restart a runner mid-assignment from here
46|   (that would create the very interrupts being measured).
47|2. A run is trustworthy only when its `*-meta.json` exists and the script's
48|   exit code was 0 (or an understood 2/3). A missing meta file means the run
49|   died before publishing; rerun it.
50|3. Snapshot stamps have second precision; recount labels must be single safe
51|   path segments (`[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*`).
